title: Afterglow Letters
welcomeEyebrow: YOUR STORY, IN A DIFFERENT LIGHT
welcomeText: An old station. An undelivered letter. Two people who remember the same evening differently. Bring your own characters, or discover theirs.

defaults.premise: You arrive at a mountain station just before its final night closes. An unsent letter carries your name, but was written ten years ago. Lin, who keeps the lanterns burning, and Xu, who preserves the town's old records, each know a different part of its story. Explore the station, build trust, and choose what the letter will mean for all of you.

lin.name: Lin
lin.tagline: The one who keeps the light
lin.profile: An adult station lamplighter with short dark hair, warm amber eyes, a dark coat and an old brass lantern. Reserved, observant, and quietly warm. Has kept a closed mountain station's lights burning for ten years. Remembers the night an unsent letter was left behind, but is reluctant to explain why.

xu.name: Xu
xu.profile: An adult town archivist with long silver-brown hair, cool gray eyes, a cream scarf and a dark green coat. Curious, wry, and empathetic. Collects old timetables and unfinished letters. Knows how to find missing pieces in other people's stories, but struggles to finish her own.
